title: Custom Retriever vs Keyword-Stuffed Noise
briefMd:
# Phase 6 · Custom Retriever vs Keyword-Stuffed Noise

The shared policy corpus contains eight noise documents that repeat common question words. A naive keyword counter ranks them above the real policies. Ship a **Python retriever** that keeps them out of your top 5.

Your program reads `/workspace/input.json` and prints `{ "results": [ { "id": "...", "passages": ["..."] } ] }` with up to 5 passages per question.

**Gate:** recall@5 ≥ 0.80 on the hidden set.
